test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, 25, ?
solution:
**Given series:**

5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, 25,?

**Logic:** Addition of (2) and (4) alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/176adca97b149706890a615c4dd8a790842e38785cf8cb2c065341a68ffaf332.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c71bc31dd56b8fdea3619273b22ebb0baf40d49b4c34db9b00949e57a8c2426.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "29".
